title: Publication Plan
description: The outcome of the reuse search, and the only thing that authorizes generation. `port-drafter` takes this as a required read and refuses unless `route` is "generate" for this exact gap, so a caller cannot reach a draft by skipping the search.

reuse_published.description: The port that already serves the contract. Empty when route is "generate".

reuse_verified_successes.description: Verified successes behind the reused port. Only publication-judge ever increments this.
